comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Online vehicle auction marketplace, not freight transportation; towing is incidental to its auction business.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Railcar manufacturer and repairer, not a freight transport service provider to shippers.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Global ocean dry bulk shipping with vessel charters; different mode, customers and economics than North American truck and intermodal.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Asset-based North American truckload carrier with dedicated and expedited services for retail and consumer shippers, like J.B. Hunt's trucking.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Seaborne dry bulk shipping for commodity shippers; different mode and market than North American intermodal and trucking.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Niche finished-vehicle car-hauling for automakers; trucking, but a specialized segment different from general intermodal and dedicated freight.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Railcar leasing and manufacturing; rents equipment rather than selling freight transportation to shippers.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: North American freight carrier with truck brokerage and last-mile delivery for retail and e-commerce shippers; overlaps J.B. Hunt's brokerage and final-mile services, though LTL is its main business.
